attainable_accuracy_track_E2a.note: added after observing that the production 100u backward rule stops FP32-working methods at the initial solve (E2 records); it does not change any production method
attainable_accuracy_track_E2a.rule: backward tolerance deliberately unattainable; refinement runs until stagnation (eta_max fails to drop 10% for 3 steps), nonfinite, GMRES budget or max_outer=30; final iterate reported; first_attainment is an offline label only

memory_policy: single process per method group at n>=32768 so that at most one n^2 FP64 factor buffer plus one FP32 factor buffer coexist with the stored matrix; admission requires free memory >= estimated need + 512 MiB

primary_baseline_denominator.rationale: cuSOLVER Xgetrf64+Xgetrs was the fastest ordinary FP64 LU on development data (0.106 s vs MAGMA native 0.149 s, MAGMA hybrid 0.41 s at n=8192 seed 9100)

rationale.gmres: native FP32-factor GMRES-IR converged in 8 inner iterations for all m in {20,40,80} and tol in {1e-2,1e-4,1e-6} on kappa=1e6 n=4096 dev cases; hetero16 GMRES-IR failed for all settings; m=40,tol=1e-4 chosen as the middle of the grid, budget 480 global
rationale.panel: MAGMA magma_sgetrf_recpanel_native panel gave 0.080 s vs 0.0865 s for the hetero16 factorization at n=8192 (8%) but its dinfo semantics differ; not adopted; cuSOLVER Xgetrf tall-panel retained

repetitions.deviation_note: 3 repetitions at n>=24576 and 2 host-mode repetitions are below the plan's 7/5 because of a 4-hour wall-clock limit; declared before any evaluation timing was viewed

seeds_by_size.note: final E4 seed plan declared at 21:44 before any E4 record existed (earlier trimmed versions superseded; see FROZEN_CONFIG_HISTORY.md)

size_ladder.note: 36864 FP64 = 10.1 GiB stored matrix; 49152 FP32 = 9.06 GiB; families geometric kappa=1e2 and clustered kappa=1e4 up to 24576 (and 32768 FP64), geometric only above; nrhs=8 at n<=8192 and n=16384 geometric seed 9200; core method group only at n>=32768 (plus IRS and MAGMA groups at 32768 geometric)

stopping_rule: stop when eta_j<=tau and omega_j<=tau for all RHS (original stored system, FP64 evaluation each outer step); nonfinite -> stop; stagnation = eta_max fails to drop by 10% for 3 consecutive outer steps; max_outer=30; GMRES global inner budget 480
